chronicle.text: Zukeik found that what Naizer had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Haigas tied wood and wood together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Ravoukair gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Shaihi tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Seirei told Mairal that Zaigeir could be believed: reputation passed on by word.
Haigas crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Haigas went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Rahuyei scratched a mark <o|-> into the ground.
Zaigeir set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Retok crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Seirei came back for food left 5 weeks before, and it was still there.
Thalun drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Mairal struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Mairal struck stone with flint and stared at what happened.
Haigas buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Deido survived an attack by a bear.
Mairal crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
Mairal tied a stone flake and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Seimek took in the orphan Thitheis, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
At (12, 39) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Haigas had put in the most.
A hungry year: 3 people starved.
Guzal struck flint with stone and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Yigukel tied a club and a carrier together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Thalun took up striking stone with flint from a mark: the first thing learned from a record.
Thalun came on the mark <v.|> and took it to mean stone being struck: the first mark read as a message.
Mairal crossed open water on something that floats and came ashore on land nobody could walk to from where they set out.
5 people now take the mark <v.|> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <./v> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
4 people now take the mark <|.^> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Neiru found that what the mark </v\> seemed to say was wrong, and put less faith in that mark.
5 people now take the mark <\\v> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Neiru tied a blade and a raft together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
The mark <\\v> has drifted: it went with stone being struck, and now, for 5 people, with wood being struck.
5 people now take the mark <^.v> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Yigukel took food that Havei had left, and was seen: the first theft from a store.
10 people now take the mark <//|> to go with flint being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
11 people now take the mark <v/|> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
9 people now take the mark <-v\> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
12 people now take the mark <\\-> to go with flint being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Boloushom attacked Zaigeir: the first violence.
12 people now take the mark </^|> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <//|> has drifted: it went with flint being struck, and now, for 8 people, with a grave.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 17, 26 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (14), illness (7), thirst (6). Average happiness 0.75. Recorded: 6 inventions, 23 firsts, 1 famines, 7 band changes, 1 new exchange partnerships, 1 new settlements.
The mark </^|> has drifted: it went with wood being struck, and now, for 10 people, with rabbits.
The mark </^|> has drifted: it went with rabbits, and now, for 8 people, with stone being struck.
3 people now tell that Neyu attacked Zaigeir. It was Boloushom. The story changed as it was passed on.
The mark <\\-> has drifted: it went with flint being struck, and now, for 6 people, with wood being struck.
14 people now take the mark <|^|> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

Years 25-49: population 17 to 15, 10 births. Deaths mostly from illness (7), old age (2), starvation (2). Average happiness 0.63. Recorded: 2 band changes, 5 new exchange partnerships, 1 new settlements.
The mark <\\-> has drifted: it went with wood being struck, and now, for 9 people, with rabbits.
6 people now take the mark <-|\> to go with stone being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Years 50-74: population 15 to 22, 16 births. Deaths mostly from illness (4), old age (3), starvation (1). Average happiness 0.67. Recorded: 1 new exchange partnerships, 1 new settlements.
The mark <\\-> has drifted: it went with rabbits, and now, for 9 people, with wood being struck.
11 people now take the mark <\v\> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
6 people now take the mark <...> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
12 people now take the mark </-|> to go with wood being struck, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
The mark <...> has drifted: it went with wood being struck, and now, for 5 people, with water.
A hungry year: 3 people starved after a poor growing season.
25 people now take the mark <o^.> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
21 people now take the mark <v..> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
8 people now take the mark <|oo> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Years 75-99: population 22 to 32, 28 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (10), illness (5), thirst (2). Average happiness 0.61. Recorded: 1 famines, 1 new exchange partnerships, 1 new settlements.
The mark <v..> has drifted: it went with a grave, and now, for 7 people, with water.
A hungry year: 4 people starved after a poor growing season.
6 people now take the mark <|o/> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Years 100-124: population 32 to 28, 24 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (12), illness (8), old age (5). Average happiness 0.57. Recorded: 1 famines.
Years 125-149: population 28 to 26, 19 births. Deaths mostly from illness (6), old age (5), thirst (5). Average happiness 0.64. Recorded: 1 new exchange partnerships, 1 new settlements.
A thirsty year: 3 people died for want of water.
10 people now take the mark <v\/> to go with shelter, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Years 150-174: population 26 to 34, 30 births. Deaths mostly from illness (6), starvation (6), old age (5). Average happiness 0.64. A quiet age.
A hungry year: 3 people starved after a poor growing season.
Years 175-199: population 34 to 29, 19 births. Deaths mostly from illness (10), starvation (8), old age (6). Average happiness 0.60. Recorded: 1 famines.
